reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "At 16, testing true one-rep maxes is not where I'd start. Your joints and technique are still developing, so build strength with solid sets of 5 to 8 reps, clean form, and a couple of reps left in the tank. That teaches you more and keeps you training for years. If you want a number, we can estimate it from your heavy sets. Want a program built around that?"}
